name: Jan Aushadhi Paracetamol
indication: Fever, headache, body ache, mild pain
precautions: Do not exceed 4 g per day. Avoid with alcohol. Consult doctor if liver disease.

name: Jan Aushadhi Metformin
indication: Type 2 diabetes mellitus, blood sugar control
precautions: Take with meals. Monitor kidney function. May cause vitamin B12 deficiency on long use.

name: Jan Aushadhi Amlodipine
precautions: May cause ankle swelling. Monitor blood pressure regularly. Do not stop abruptly.

name: Jan Aushadhi Atorvastatin
indication: High cholesterol, prevention of heart disease
precautions: Take at night. Report unexplained muscle pain. Check liver enzymes periodically.

name: Jan Aushadhi Telmisartan
precautions: Monitor potassium levels. Avoid in pregnancy. Can cause dizziness on standing.

name: Jan Aushadhi Ranitidine
precautions: Take before meals. Consult doctor if long-term use needed. May affect vitamin B12.

name: Jan Aushadhi Pantoprazole
precautions: Take 30 min before breakfast. Long-term use may reduce magnesium. Avoid with clopidogrel.

name: Jan Aushadhi Aspirin
indication: Low-dose for heart attack prevention, pain, fever
precautions: Take after food. Risk of bleeding. Avoid if on blood thinners without doctor advice.

name: Jan Aushadhi Metoprolol
indication: High blood pressure, angina, heart failure support
precautions: Do not stop suddenly. Monitor heart rate. May cause fatigue or cold hands.

name: Jan Aushadhi Glimepiride
precautions: Take with breakfast. Watch for low blood sugar (hypoglycemia). Carry a sweet.

name: Jan Aushadhi Cetirizine
precautions: May cause drowsiness. Avoid driving if affected. Do not take with alcohol.

name: Jan Aushadhi Azithromycin
precautions: Complete full course. Only for bacterial infections. May cause stomach upset.

name: Jan Aushadhi Amoxicillin
indication: Bacterial infections, throat infection, dental infection
precautions: Complete full course. Check for penicillin allergy. Take with or without food.

name: Jan Aushadhi Vitamin D3
precautions: Take with milk/fat for absorption. Weekly dosing common. Avoid overdose.

name: Jan Aushadhi Calcium
precautions: Take with food. Separate from thyroid medicine by 4 hours. Drink plenty water.

name: Jan Aushadhi Omeprazole
precautions: Take before breakfast. Long-term use may weaken bones. Avoid with clopidogrel.

name: Jan Aushadhi Losartan
precautions: Monitor potassium and kidney function. Avoid in pregnancy. Report swelling.

name: Jan Aushadhi Diclofenac
precautions: Take after food. Avoid long-term use. Risk of stomach ulcer and kidney issues.

name: Jan Aushadhi Insulin Glargine
precautions: Inject under skin, never muscle. Monitor blood sugar. Store refrigerated.

name: Jan Aushadhi Levocetirizine
precautions: Take at night. May cause drowsiness. Avoid alcohol.

name: Jan Aushadhi Rosuvastatin
precautions: Take at night. Report muscle pain. Periodic liver tests recommended.

name: Jan Aushadhi Metformin SR
precautions: Take with evening meal. Gentler on stomach. Swallow whole, do not crush.

name: Jan Aushadhi Cough Syrup
precautions: May cause drowsiness. Avoid with other cough medicines. Not for chronic cough.

name: Jan Aushadhi Multivitamin
indication: General weakness, nutritional support for seniors
precautions: Take after food. Do not exceed dose. Not a substitute for balanced diet.
